highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and removes avoidable allocations across color, shaping, and text APIs.
highlights_body: The release improves WebAssembly exception handling, fixes an encoded-image resource leak, and delivers lower-allocation HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper paths.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 151 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability fixes.
SKColor hex parsing gains ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for allocation-conscious callers.
Creating an image from encoded data with a subset rectangle no longer leaks its native resource.

bullets.lead: Color and text hot paths reduce allocations
bullets.detail: Ports color conversion and premultiplication work to managed code, removes tag parsing allocations, and exposes shaped glyph results through zero-copy spans.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and support for the current .NET WebAssembly exception model.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly build cleanup, managed color conversion, and allocation-free HarfBuzz text input

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m151 line and cleaned up WebAssembly native builds.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added managed color and text-path optimizations plus updated WebAssembly support.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate completed m151 stability updates and fixed the encoded-image resource leak.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp eliminates UTF-8 input and tag parsing allocations and improves access to shaped glyph results.
